newsitem.title: POLAND: PBR UNDERWRITES TWO POLISH ISSUES.
newsitem.headline: PBR UNDERWRITES TWO POLISH ISSUES.

text.p: Polish Development Bank SA (PBR) subunderwrote Polish road builder Gdanskie Przedsiebiorstwo Robot Drogowych SA (GPRD) and confectioner Jutrzenka SA new issues, the bank said in a statement.

PBR subunderwrote 250,000 shares of the 2,248,700-share GPRD initial public offering and said the stand-by fee was 2.5 percent. The issue was earlier underwritten by Wood & Company at a stand-by fee of 3.5 percent.
PBR said it also sub-underwrote 200,000 shares of new Jutrzenka issue, whose size has not yet been announced. It said the stand-by fee was five percent.
It said it would buy the shares at 67 zlotys, if the main market's WIG index was above 13,200 points and at 55 zlotys if it fell below the level.
On Thursday the all-share WIG closed at 13,628.4 and Jutrzenka shares closed at 56.0 zlotys.
The Jutrzenka issue was earlier underwritten by Wood Securities B.V. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
